metadata.warning: These are official geographic reference anchors, not exact island observation coordinates. BC Hydro's public release describes the island as west of Finlay Bay and later along the Ospika Arm but does not publish exact island coordinates.

properties.name: Finlay Bay
properties.role: reference anchor for first documented area
properties.case_description: BC Hydro describes the earliest known satellite observation as west of Finlay Bay.

properties.name: Ospika River mouth
properties.role: reference anchor for Ospika Arm relocation area
properties.case_description: BC Hydro says the floating mass came to rest along the shoreline of the Ospika Arm. The Ospika River mouth is used only as a public geographic anchor for that arm.

properties.name: W.A.C. Bennett Dam
properties.case_description: BC Hydro says the island moved farther away from the dam.
